figure_notes.name: disclosure-family-effects
figure_notes.title: Figure 1. Public-disclosure family estimates and weights
figure_notes.note: Following-year GDP-weighted country comparisons. All eight supported families are shown. Bars are 95% normal-reference conditional country intervals. Right panel: sampled pre-policy market-cap masses, normalised across these families; dashed line is equal family weight. Each family has its own supported countries and cohorts.

figure_notes.name: disclosure-event-profiles
figure_notes.title: Figure 2. Public-disclosure liquidity before and after implementation
figure_notes.note: Five public-disclosure families on fixed company support in years -3 through +3. Year -1 is the reference. Pointwise 95% conditional country intervals are shaded. The sample differs from the eight-family short window and six-family longer-window main samples. Pre-policy differences and common legal waves limit a causal interpretation.

figure_notes.name: disclosure-diffusion-comparison
figure_notes.title: Figure 3. Diffusion associations and common policy waves
figure_notes.note: Separate adoption-status linear probability models under both family weights. Compare country-family plus common year effects with country-family plus family-year effects on identical rows. Horizontal intervals are 95% country-clustered t intervals. Predictor units differ by panel and are stated in each heading. A change across fixed-effect structures is not evidence that either coefficient is causal.
